# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile portrait top-down survival action game called **Vice Grid: Heat Run**. The player controls a neon getaway car in an open-city chase. Preserve the protected mechanics of joystick movement, tap attack, held heavy ram, boost cooldown, enemy pursuit/contact damage, loot/currency, inventory/garage equipment, escalating waves/heat, game-over, and restart. Express the prompt — Grand Theft Auto open-city action. A Grand Theft Auto open-city action game with urban sandbox freedom, crime chaos, vehicle chases, satire, police pursuit, street-level ambition, dark humor, and open-world systemic mischief with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range. — through an animated city grid, police pursuit hazards, cash/mod pickups, wanted heat HUD, darkly comic bust text, large touch controls, and 4:7 to 9:16 portrait readability.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a mobile-first top-down canvas survival/action game. It starts immediately, keeps a player avatar in a bounded viewport, spawns enemies from screen edges, lets the player move with a virtual joystick, attack by tapping the canvas, hold a heavy attack button, dash/roll with cooldown, open an inventory panel, equip items/weapons, gain currency and loot from defeated enemies, unlock stronger weapons at kill thresholds, escalate waves over time, lose health on contact, and restart after game over.

## Protected mechanics
- Real-time canvas loop and immediate play state.
- Joystick movement direction/speed semantics and bounded playfield.
- Tap/light attack, held heavy attack, range/cone hit tests, cooldowns, damage variation.
- Boost/roll teleport with cooldown and short invulnerability.
- Enemy edge spawns, chase variants, contact damage, HP bars, escalating waves.
- Loot/currency, item auto-selection, weapon unlock thresholds, HUD updates.
- Game-over overlay and restart flow.

## Rebuilt target
Vice Grid: Heat Run preserves those mechanics while presenting them as an urban sandbox chase: a getaway car free-roams a portrait city grid, rams pursuit units, collects cash/mods, raises street rep, and survives increasing heat.
